column1: 21216§plummet§ˈplʌmɪt§However, when a major fast-food company then made the same demands after customer purchases of its hamburgers plummeted, the meat industry complied within weeks.§然而，当一家大型快餐公司在其汉堡包销量**直线下降**后提出了相同的要求时，肉类行业在几周内就遵守了规定。§
21217§glacial§ˈɡleɪʃl§These giant stones are part of an ancient glacial deposit.§这些巨石是古**冰川**沉积物的一部分。§
21218§dock§dɒk§There are a number of historic ships docked in the harbour.§港口**停泊**着很多具有历史价值的船只。§
21219§argument§ˈɑːɡjumənt§Support your argument with examples and relevant evidence, please.§请用实例和相关证据来支持你的**论点**。§
21220§chase§tʃeɪs§The babysitter chased the kids around the yard.§照看孩子的人**追着**孩子满院子地跑。§改译文：chase 是追，不是跟着
21221§brochure§ˈbrəʊʃə(r)§Please inform us of your trade terms and forward samples and a product brochure.§请告知贵方的交易条款，并寄来货样及产品**小册子**。§
21222§convince§kənˈvɪns§That man tries to convince the employer that any shortcomings he has will not prevent him from doing a good job.§那个男人努力让雇主**相信**，他身上的任何缺点都不会妨碍他做好工作。§改例句：That 后应为单数 man，men 错
21223§teem§tiːm§To create new colonies, a healthy hive, teeming with bees, can be separated into two boxes.§为了培育新的蜂群，可以将一个**装满**蜜蜂的健康蜂箱分成两个。§

21224§confront§kənˈfrʌnt§Growth and environmentalism can actually go hand in hand, if politicians have the courage to confront the vested interest that subsidies create.§如果政客们有勇气**面对**财政补助所产生的既得利益，那么经济增长和环境保护实际上可以共同发展。§
21225§exhibition§ˌeksɪˈbɪʃn§The woman's exhibition met with great opposition from Parliament.§女性作品**展览会**遭遇了国会的强烈反对。§
21226§whereas§ˌweərˈæz§Some of the studies show positive results, whereas others do not.§一些研究结果令人满意，其他**则**不然。§
21227§additional§əˈdɪʃənl§In recent years a number of additional countries have subscribed to the Ottawa Charter.§近几年，**另有**许多国家同意加入《渥太华宪章》。§改译文：「又」不是 additional 的意思，改为「另有」
21228§overlapping§ˌəʊvəˈlæpɪŋ§The two girls of overlapping interests went shopping together.§两个兴趣**有交集**的女孩一起去购物了。§改译文：overlapping 是部分重合，不是相同，改为「有交集」
21229§poultry§ˈpəʊltri§The poultry farmers keep ducks as well as chickens.§这些**家禽**养殖户既饲养鸭子也养鸡。§

21230§pregnancy§ˈpregnənsi§They are especially vulnerable because of pregnancy but also because of osteoporosis, which I personally believe to be the major cause of the problem for women.§她们的身体特别容易变得脆弱，一方面是因为**怀孕**，一方面是因为骨质疏松，我个人认为后者是导致这一问题的主要原因。§
21231§confirmation§ˌkɒnfəˈmeɪʃn§Hundreds of students are waiting for confirmation of the test results.§数百名学生都在等待着**确认**考试成绩。§
21232§unquote§ˌʌnˈkwəʊt§The President unquoted his quotation with "have a nice day here".§总统先生通过“祝你们在这里玩得愉快”来**结束**他的引语。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
21233§embezzlement§ɪmˈbezlmənt§The three criminals are arrested for embezzlement of company funds.§这三名罪犯因为**盗用**公司资金而被逮捕。§
21234§acrobatic§ˌækrəˈbætɪk§Jane used to be an acrobatic dancer but three years ago, she started to learn fencing.§简曾经是一名**杂技**舞蹈演员，但是三年前她开始学习击剑。§改例句：three years's ago 多了 's，应为 three years ago
21235§numerous§ˈnjuːmərəs§Numerous overseas visitors have come to see how the program works.§**众多**海外游客到这里来观看这个项目是如何运作的。§
21236§balcony§ˈbælkəni§From your cabin balcony you'll find that you cannot see anyone else and the only sound you should hear is the birds' singing.§从你小屋的**阳台**看不到任何人，听到的只有鸟鸣。§
21237§postgraduate§ˌpəʊstˈɡrædʒuət§I've got a place in a Postgraduate Certificate in Education course starting in September.§我已经参加了9月份开学的教育学**研究生**文凭课程。§

21238§well-being§ˈwel biːɪŋ§They stated, "health is a complete state of physical, mental and social well-being and is not merely the absence of disease."§他们声称，“健康是集生理、精神和社会**安宁**为一体的完整状态，而不仅仅是不生病。”§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
21239§prime§praɪm§He's a prime candidate to captain the team this season.§他是本赛季队长的**最佳**人选。§
21240§settle§ˈsetl§They are offspring of the first Europeans who settled in China.§他们是最早在中国**定居**的欧洲人的后裔。§
21241§fallow§ˈfæləʊ§Overuse of fertilisers may cause farmers to stop rotating crops or leave their land fallow.§过度使用肥料可能会导致农民停止农作物的轮作或让土地**休耕**。§
21242§troupe§truːp§A troupe of dancers from Italy is one of the leading attractions in the festival.§一支来自意大利的舞蹈**队**在节日里最引人注目。§
21243§premise§ˈpremɪs§His agreement of this investment is based on the premise that all people equally share the risk.§基于所有人平均分担风险的**前提**，他同意了该项投资。§
21244§discerning§dɪˈsɜːnɪŋ§Only the discerning customers can recognize this jade decoration as a high quality product.§只有**眼光敏锐**的顾客才能识别出这件玉饰是高品质产品。§
21245§niggle§ˈnɪɡl§Tina wears a frown these days; there must be something niggling her.§蒂娜这些天眉头紧锁，一定是有什么事**困扰**着她。§改例句：原句 that 引导从句不当、something niggled her 缺关系词，改为分号和 something niggling her
21246§prospectus§prəˈspektəs§I picked up a really detailed prospectus for Tom.§我为汤姆挑选了一本内容相当详尽的**说明书**。§
21247§liaise§liˈeɪz§He had the right to liaise directly with the police while writing the report.§他在写报告的过程中，有权直接与警方**联系**。§
21248§excavation§ˌekskəˈveɪʃn§The new excavations are open to the public this weekend in Shanxi Museum.§新**出土的文物**将于本周末在山西博物馆对公众开放展览。§
21249§continental§ˌkɒntɪˈnentl§The company grew rapidly and has been providing holidays in continental Europe for the last fifteen years.§公司发展迅速，在过去15年里一直为员工提供去欧洲**大陆**度假的机会。§
21250§modernism§ˈmɒdənɪzəm§Many architects contributed to the development of modernism in the first half of last century.§上世纪上半叶，许多建筑师都为**现代主义**的发展做出了贡献。§
21251§artery§ˈɑːtəri§The patient underwent an operation to unblock his coronary artery.§这位病人接受了一次冠状**动脉**疏通手术。§
21252§premium§ˈpriːmiəm§The coffee we're drinking is premium.§我们喝的是**特级**咖啡。§
21253§glamor§ˈglæmə(r)§Traveling abroad can offer you an opportunity to enjoy the glamor of other countries.§出国旅游能为你提供一个领略异国**风情**的机会。§
21254§barbecue§ˈbɑːbɪkjuː§Membership gives wide access to activities like basketball and football as well as barbecues and other social functions.§会员可以参加各种活动，诸如打篮球、踢足球、**烧烤**以及其他社交集会。§
21255§material§məˈtɪəriəl§Glass is the great building material of the future.§玻璃是未来重要的建筑**材料**。§
21256§adapt§əˈdæpt§All those older buildings in the city have been adapted for present-day use.§城里的旧建筑已经全部经过**改造**，以作今日之用。§
21257§gullibly§ˈgʌləbli§The tourist finds pleasure in landscapes and gullibly enjoys pseudo-events.§游客从欣赏风景中得到快乐，并且**轻信地**享受模拟活动所带来的乐趣。§改译文：gullibly 是“轻信地”，原译“可以轻易”译错了
21258§sift§sɪft§We sift through the information carefully to find a clue that will help us.§我们仔细**研究**资料以便找出对我们有帮助的线索。§
21259§succession§səkˈseʃn§She has won the award for the third year in succession.§这是她**连续**第三年获得此奖项。§
21260§spark§spɑːk§In the Stone Age, tool-makers discovered that chipping flints produced sparks.§在石器时代，工匠们发现敲凿燧石能产生**火花**。§
21261§sympathy§ˈsɪmpəθi§This seeming sympathy didn't soothe her distress.§这种表面上的**同情**并不能减轻她的悲痛。§
21262§chill§tʃɪl§The group asks for a specially designed camping cool box, which will keep food and drinks chilled.§这个团体在寻求一种设计独特的野营冷藏箱，用以**冷藏**食物和饮料。§

21263§multinational§ˌmʌltiˈnæʃnəl§When you think of any organization, a family business or a multinational company, they are all fundamentally a group of people working together.§当你想到任何组织、家族企业或**跨国**公司时，从根本上来说他们都是一群在一起工作的人。§

21264§exposure§ɪkˈspəʊʒə(r)§On the positive side, exposure to such diversity helps encourage creativity which is generally an asset to a company.§从积极的一面来看，**接触**这样的多样性有助于激发创造性，这对公司来说通常都是一笔财富。§改译文：「处于…下」不是 exposure 的意思，改为「接触」
21265§fierce§fɪəs§There is fierce competition in the examination.§考试竞争非常**激烈**。§
21266§crime§kraɪm§Without the death penalty our lives are less secure and violent crime will increase.§如果没有死刑，我们的生命会更不安全，暴力**犯罪**活动也将增加。§
21267§constitute§ˈkɒnstɪtjuːt§The lid constitutes twenty-five percent of the can's total weight.§盖子**占**罐子总重的25％。§
21268§deceive§dɪˈsiːv§Mary deceived the interviewer about her past experience.§玛丽在自己的过去经历上对面试官**撒了谎**。§
21269§haul§hɔːl§Every spring a beekeeper may move up to flowering fields and haul the hives back to where he starts out in winter.§每年春天，养蜂人都会迁往花地，冬天再将蜂箱**搬运**回来。§
21270§emission§ɪˈmɪʃn§The new fuel can save energy and cut carbon dioxide emissions.§新型燃料可以节约能源，降低二氧化碳的**排放量**。§
21271§procession§prəˈseʃn§The soldiers lined the route of the procession.§士兵们沿**游行**的道路排成一列。§改译文：procession 是游行队伍，改为「游行」
21272§bistro§ˈbiːstrəʊ§The Geneva Bistro is always a popular place in this area.§这家杜松子**酒馆**在这一带很受欢迎。§
21273§crash§kræʃ§The two cars crashed into each other.§两辆汽车猛烈**相撞**。§
21274§workforce§ˈwɜːkfɔːs§The rise in the female workforce in the European Community is a positive trend.§欧共体中女性**劳动人口**的增加是一个积极的趋势。§
21275§surpass§səˈpɑːs§His success has surpassed all expectations.§他所取得的成功远远**超过**了预期。§
21276§sociology§ˌsəʊsiˈɒlədʒi§In the first semester you'll be taking four subjects: psychology, sociology, history and economics.§第一学期你将学习四门课：心理学、**社会学**、历史学和经济学。§
21277§violent§ˈvaɪələnt§Although news broadcasts are violent, people felt they shouldn't be banned.§虽然新闻广播言辞**激烈**，但人们还是觉得不应该将其取消。§
21278§frock§frɒk§WSPU members wear their official uniforms of a white frock decorated with purple, yellow and green accessories.§妇女社会与政治同盟的成员穿着白色的官方制服**裙**，上面配有紫、黄、绿三色配饰。§
21279§epidemic§ˌepɪˈdemɪk§The government declared that no major epidemic diseases prevailed in this area.§政府宣布该地区没有流行重大的**传染性**疾病。§
21280§grab§græb§Promotions in the store stand out and grab our attention.§商店里的促销广告非常显眼，**吸引**了我们的视线。§
21281§appliance§əˈplaɪəns§On Wednesdays, I repair electrical appliances free of charge.§每逢周三，我都给人免费修理**电器**。§
21282§facility§fəˈsɪləti§There are facilities for high-energy particle experiments in our research centre.§我们的研究中心有高能粒子实验**设备**。§
21283§consolation§ˌkɒnsəˈleɪʃn§The results of this research may be a great consolation to left-handers.§这项研究的结果对惯用左手者来说可能是个极大的**安慰**。§
